entities.name: Joseph Rémi Léopold Delbœuf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Rémi Léopold Delbœuf was a Belgian experimental psychologist who studied visual illusions including his work on the Delboeuf illusion. He studied and taught philosophy, mathematics, and psychophysics. He published works across a diverse range of subjects including the curative effects of hypnotism.
